origin: A format Snapchat introduced in 2013 and Instagram adopted under the same name in 2016, which made it widespread.
whenToUse: Light content to flick through, such as short news or today's menu.
There are only a few pieces of content.
whenNotToUse: Text that takes time to read (auto-advance gets in the way).
Information people need to find again.

alternatives.name: Carousel
alternatives.reason: Moving through slides within a page.

accessibility: Previous, next, pause, and close are all named buttons.
The pause button and a long press stop auto-advance (WCAG 2.2.2).
With reduced motion, it doesn't advance on its own.
The story title is read with aria-live when it changes.
